title: Kangana Ranaut clarifies ‘gutter generation’ remark amid backlash: ‘Kya aap apne beti ko aisa sikhayenge?’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

BJP MP Kangana Ranaut during the Monsoon Session of the Parliament. (PTI Photo/Shahbaz Khan)(PTI07_21_2026_000081B) (PTI) What Kangana shared Kangana made a reel for her ‘media friends’ and went on to say, “Hum log nahi chahte hai ki hamare ghar ke bachcho ko koi ashleel sabdo se ye sexualise kar de. Ghar ke buzurgo ke saamne sharmindagi mehsoos ho. Hum iss tarah ka behaviour accept nahi karte hain aur usko normalise nahi hone denge (We do not want our kids to use these vulgar words and get sexualised. It will bring shame. We don't accept this kind of behaviour and won't normalise it).”

Adding to this, Kangana shared that the media is ganging up on her and did not show how she congratulated the Skyroot programme and also wished the best for the NEET examinees. But for a few followers and comments, these channels have shown her remarks, and some feminists are also questioning why women should have the ‘burden of dignity.’

Meanwhile, She added, “Excuse me? Kya aap apne beti ko aisa sikhayenge? Discipline mein rehna koi choice nahi hai! Agar aapko samaj mein rehna hai toh samvidhaan ke hisaab se chalna padega. Aapki aazadi waha khatam hoti hain jaha mera naak aur kaan shuru hote hain (Will you teach this to your daughters? It is not a choice to stay disciplined. If you want to stay in society, then you have to follow the constitution. Your freedom stops at my nose and ears).”
Notably, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Kangana Ranaut (@kanganaranaut)

As per the latest buzz, Kangana added that just because someone does not know her family members well does not give them the right to verbally abuse and call them slurs. “PM ko exam buddy kehte hain bachche. Koi unko leader, dost, parivaar, koi unko bhagwaan maanta hai. Kisi ki feelings hurt nahi kar sakte hai. Ye koi cool banna nahi hai. Ye ek basic civic sense hai aur agar apko nahi aati hai toh sikhna padega (People call our PM exam buddy. Some consider him a friend, a leader and even their God. This is basic civic sense, and you need to learn it).”

In further updates, The star urged people not to be influenced by the ‘feminazi’ and ruin their lives. “Iss bhaundepan ko sirf aap apne kamre mein display kar sakte hai. Bahar jakar aapko maryada mein rehna padega… Aap ka andhakaar wali zindagi ho jayegi (This rubbish can be displayed indoors only. Outside, you will have to stay within limits or else the future will be dark).”

On top of that, She concluded, saying that science tells us that human life is based on evolution, but the feminazi is bent on influencing animalistic tendencies, which can only lead to jail. Kangana shared that she only hopes that people also evolve rather than regress further, and wished everyone on the occasion of Guru Purnima.

Earlier, Kangana had criticized the Gen Z protests . Kangana wrote, “Never in my life, I have seen so much ugliness in one place. These reels from Gen Z protests are puke-inducing, the way they speak and the kind of language they are using. Never in my life have I seen everything in each and every frame so jarring and so crass all at once.”

title: Alia Bhatt urges fans to support Assam flood relief; says “It happens every year and it still catches us off guard”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star shared an emotional note on Instagram, pledging to highlight relief initiatives as Assam continues to battle one of its worst flood crises.

Adding to this, In her note, Alia highlighted the scale of the humanitarian crisis, pointing out the loss of lives, widespread displacement, and the destruction faced by thousands of families. She also stressed the need for both immediate relief and long-term rehabilitation efforts. She wrote, “Right now, floods are affecting so many parts of our country with Assam being among the hardest hit, facing an incredibly challenging time. More than 60 lives have been lost. Lakhs of people have been displaced. Entire families have lost their homes, their land, their livestock... and for some, even the people they love. It happens every year and it still catches us off guard.”

Meanwhile, The star further opened up that she would be using her platform to share information about organizations involved in relief work on the ground and encouraged people to contribute in whatever way they could. The note also added, “Assam needs immediate relief right now, and it'll need support for the long road to recovery. If you've been wondering how you can help, I'll be sharing a few ways we can support relief efforts over the next few days, through organisations working on the ground. #CircleOfHope.”

Notably, Alia is among several celebrities who have spoken about the situation in Assam, with many taking to social media to amplify relief efforts and encourage donations. As rescue and rehabilitation operations continue, public figures have been using their platforms to draw attention to the needs of those affected by the disaster.

As per the latest buzz, Every year, seasonal flooding impacts large parts of Assam, leading to significant damage to homes, agricultural land, and public infrastructure. This year's floods have once again displaced lakhs of residents, prompting relief agencies and volunteers to intensify rescue and support operations across the state.

In further updates, On the professional front, Alia Bhatt was last seen in YRF's spy thriller Alpha , alongside Sharvari, Bobby Deol, and Anil Kapoor. She will next be seen in Sanjay Leela Bhansali's Love & War , co-starring Ranbir Kapoor and Vicky Kaushal. The movie is currently slated for a theatrical rollout in January 2027.

On top of that, With her latest appeal, Alia Bhatt has urged her followers to look beyond social media and contribute towards relief efforts, while emphasizing that communities affected by the Assam floods will require sustained support even after the immediate crisis subsides.

title: Karan Johar dedicates his career to ‘bhai’ Shah Rukh Khan, Aditya Chopra on Guru Purnima: ‘Life changing for me’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

On Guru Purnima, July 29, filmmaker Karan Johar took to social media to dedicate his career to Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan and filmmaker Aditya Chopra . Revealing how two conversations with them changed the trajectory of his life, Karan shared that he is only where he is today because of both of them. He also posted old pictures with them both in his dedication.

Adding to this, Karan Johar posted an old picture with Shah Rukh Khan on Guru Purnima. Assisting Aditya Chopra on DDLJ The 1995 Dilwale Dulhania Le Jayenge was a game-changer for the movie industry, and especially for everyone involved. Karan recalled that at 1 AM, Aditya asked him to assist with the movie as he was about to leave Mumbai for further studies. He was the one who told Karan he had to be a director.

Meanwhile, “I was melodramatic and filmy and the only thing I needed was an interval because I was always on a treadmill (not the ones gyms are famous for) … he shared if I didn’t pursue this path I would be making a huge mistake … I couldn’t sleep that night and then in my true filmy self… I went dramatically to my father the next morning and asked him for a year of my life…. A year on a movie set …. He looked at my moist eyes (looked like tears but was actually just lack of sleep and a developing stye) and shared “beta (son) … will you know what to do on a set?”” recalled Karan.

Notably, The filmmaker admits that he didn’t know how to work on a set, but promised his father, Yash Johar , to work hard and follow every instruction. “He shared… “ that will make you a producer …. To be a director you need only and only Passion”…Passionate I was but wasn’t sure anyone would believe me at that point…. only Adi did… only him…” wrote Karan.
As per the latest buzz, View this post on Instagram A post shared by Karan Johar (@karanjohar)

In further updates, The 1998 movie Kuch Kuch Hota Hai launched Karan’s career and he says it’s all thanks to Shah Rukh banking on him. “My next conversation was with Bhai @iamsrk on a hill top in Switzerland … I was looking at the mountains (pretending to be home sick and seeking sympathy) he came to me and shared “tu director banega and teri pehli movie main karoonga (You will become a director and I will star in your movie)”… i thought to myself … he’s probably low on oxygen and may not completely know what he’s saying …” he recalled.

On top of that, Once they returned to India, the star followed up with Yash, who was also ‘mildly hard of hearing’ and wasn’t sure of what Shah Rukh had shared. “But Srk was serious… he believed in me for a reason I can’t quite comprehend even today … (just like Adi did),” wrote Karan. He summed up with note with, “I love you Adi and Bhai… I am here with my strengths and flaws….my ups and downs … my wins and my losses … only and only because of the both of you …. You both are the only reason I can tell stories today #happygurupurnima.”

Karan Johar most of late produced Chand Mera Dil, while Aditya produced Alpha. After the 2023 films Pathaan, Jawan, and Dunki, Shah Rukh will return to the screen this year with Siddharth Anand’s King . It will also star his daughter, Suhana Khan along with Abhishek Bachchan, Anil Kapoor, Jackie Shroff, Arshad Warsi and special appearances of Rani Mukerji and Deepika Padukone.

title: Delhi HC directs removal of 'Kala Hiran' teaser on Salman Khan's plea
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

New Delhi, The Delhi High Court has in an interim order directed the removal of a teaser for the movie "Kala Hiran: The Battle for Legal", purportedly based on star Salman Khan, and other related posts from online platforms, after he objected to them.

Adding to this, Delhi HC directs removal of 'Kala Hiran' teaser on Salman Khan's plea Justice Jyoti Singh, in the order passed on July 27 on Khan's application, shared the makers of 'Kala Hiran' cannot exploit the 59-year-old Bollywood star's name, mannerisms and other distinctive attributes for commercial gains without his authorisation or disseminate content that injures his reputation.

Meanwhile, The court observed that using social media to disseminate content that violates personality rights or harms reputation exacerbates the mischief, given the speed, reach and permanence of digital publications.

Notably, The judge noted that the movie's teaser refers to incidents and characters which are part of a pending appeal in the blackbuck poaching case and also imputes acts of intimidation of witnesses and investigation machinery, which prima facie irreparably and gravely damage the star's goodwill and reputation built over years.

As per the latest buzz, "In my view, prima facie, the cumulative narrative from the impugned teaser and the posts is that proposed defendants have launched a promotional campaign/strategy to commercially exploit plaintiff's personality rights and public persona, without his consent or authorisation, to generate commercial interest in the movie and attract viewers and are thus infringing Plaintiff's personality and publicity rights," the court observed.
In further updates, Khan's application forms part of his lawsuit on protection of his personality rights.

On top of that, "Plaintiff has the right to determine the manner in which his persona is commercially exploited and proposed defendants cannot exploit Plaintiff's name, mannerisms and other distinctive attributes for commercial gains, without authority and/or publish and disseminate content which injures the reputation of the Plaintiff in public.

"On a prima facie view of the nature of the content of the teaser and accompanying posts, it is imperative that the same are taken down without delay and subject to the final outcome of the application," it concluded.

title: Shehnaaz Gill reveals why she now refuses to work without fair pay: ‘Did work for free, but uski izzat nahi mili’
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Star Shehnaaz Gill has candidly spoken about the realities of navigating the entertainment industry, revealing that she has worked on projects without charging a fee in the past, only to realise that the gesture did not earn her the respect she had hoped for. Shehnaaz shared remuneration has now become a non-negotiable factor before she signs a movie. She added that she often has to fight for the fee she believes she deserves.

Adding to this, Shehnaaz Gill made her Bollywood debut alongside Salman Khan in Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan. Shehnaaz gets candid In an interview with News18, Shehnaaz reflected on her career journey and opened up that financial compensation now plays an important role in the projects she chooses.

Meanwhile, “Money is very important. It gives you respect. When I ask for what I deserve today, I sometimes get that, sometimes I don’t and sometimes it’s lesser than what I quote for myself. But har kisi ko apne haq ke liye ladna chahiye (Everyone should fight for one’s own right). I work really hard and I’ve been through a lot to reach the place that I’m in today," shared Shehnaaz, who of late had a rollout with Ishqnama.
Notably, Unlike her early years in the industry, she no longer seems willing to take on projects without being paid.

As per the latest buzz, Shehnaaz shared, “Yes, there was a time when I did a lot of work for free. But uski mujhe izzat nahi mili. Maine logo ke liye itna kuch kiya hai (I didn’t get any respect for that. I did so much for so many people). But now, I do fight for what I deserve. I compromise only on ocassions when the movie that I’ve been offered is really good… Sometimes, you know that they won’t pay you well but you still get into it knowing that the script is meaningful. But if you ask me if I’ve ever done a project just for money by compromising on the quality of the work, I’ll have to tell you that I’ve never done that.”
In further updates, When it comes to films, Shehnaaz asserted that she doesn’t let money come in the way.

On top of that, Shehnaaz initially rose to fame in the Punjabi entertainment industry before gaining widespread recognition for her appearance on Bigg Boss 13 and her closeness with late star Sidharth Shukla . She transitioned to Bollywood with her debut in Kisi Ka Bhai Kisi Ki Jaan, alongside Salman Khan , Pooja Hegde, Venkatesh Daggubati, and Bhumika Chawla in 2013.

She also featured in Thank You For Coming, featuring Bhumi Pednekar , Dolly Singh, Kusha Kapila, and Shibani Bedi, which premiered at the 2023 Toronto International Movie Festival (TIFF). She also appeared in the music video for the song Sajna Ve Sajna from the 2024 movie Vicky Vidya Ka Woh Wala Video, which starred Triptii Dimri and Rajkummar Rao. She was also seen in Ikk Kudi.

title: BTS May Be Headed For Its Biggest Year At The Grammys Yet
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:

Forbes contributors publish independent expert analyses and insights. Hugh McIntyre covers music, with a focus on the global charts. Follow Author Jul 23, 2026, 02:00pm EDT --:-- / --:-- This voice experience is generated by AI. Learn more . This voice experience is generated by AI. Learn more . Summary BTS could have its biggest Grammy year yet at the 2027 ceremony thanks to Arirang, “Swim” and “Normal.” The group remains winless after five nominations, but the new Best Asian Pop Music Performance category may give the septet its clearest path to a first trophy as a performing act.

Adding to this, With two singles and an album eligible and a new category — Best Asian Pop Music Performance — seemingly made specifically for the band, BTS may soon win a Grammy. LOS ANGELES, CA - FEBRUARY 10: South Korean boy band BTS attends the 61st Annual GRAMMY Awards at Staples Center on February 10, 2019 in Los Angeles, California. (Photo by Steve Granitz/WireImage) WireImage K-pop became a major commercial force in the United States years ago, and its popularity continues to grow all the time. Grammy recognition has moved much more slowly, as most of the genre’s biggest singers and groups have yet to be acknowledged by the Recording Academy.

Meanwhile, Only a select few K-pop stars have collected nominations, including BTS and Blackpink singer Rosé, while the women behind Huntr/x from KPop Demon Hunters also competed at the 2026 ceremony. “Apt.” and “Golden” became the first songs by K-pop artists to be nominated for Song of the Year, with the former also making history in the hugely competitive Record of the Year field.

Notably, “Golden” became the first K-pop recording to win a Grammy only a few months back when its writers claimed Best Song Written for Visual Media honor. The prize went to the songwriters rather than the performers who comprise Huntr/x, meaning a K-pop musical act has still never won a Grammy as the named performer.

As per the latest buzz, That could change at the 2027 ceremony. The Recording Academy is introducing Best Asian Pop Music Performance, a category that recognizes K-pop, J-pop, C-pop and other pop recordings that meaningfully incorporate at least one Asian language. BTS will surely be considered one of the early favorites, but which song the septet submits could determine whether the outfit finally wins.

In further updates, BTS has received five Grammy nominations without winning any trophies. “Dynamite,” “Butter” and “My Universe,” the group’s collaboration with Coldplay, all competed for Best Pop Duo/Group Performance. “Yet to Come (The Most Beautiful Moment)” was nominated for Best Music Video. BTS was even included in Coldplay’s Album of the Year nomination for Music of the Spheres , which features “My Universe.”

On top of that, That last appearance technically brought BTS into the Grammys’ largest race, but none of the septet’s own albums has been nominated. Its 2026 project Arirang may change that, though Album of the Year is sure to be especially competitive this time around.

Arirang arrived this spring as BTS’s long-awaited comeback album. The collection gave the group another No. 1 in America, and it features several recordings that could be distributed throughout different Grammy fields.

title: Sadie Sink Is Chasing New Challenges
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:

After Stranger Things wrapped, Sink took a break from TV and went to the stage, appearing on Broadway in John Proctor Is the Villain —for which she was nominated for a Tony Award—and in the West End in Romeo & Juliet , opposite Noah Jupe. She then joined the Spiderverse in a much-anticipated, still closely guarded role in Spider-Man: Brand New Day. But the theater was her first home; Sink got her start in local and regional theater, which led her to a role on Broadway as another famous redhead: the one and only Annie. “My foundation as an star was rooted in the theater,” Sink shared. “Returning to it with John Proctor , the first play I’d done in 10 years, I was excited to rediscover the space as an adult.”

Adding to this, Sink noted that spending time with a character in the rehearsal room is one of her favorite parts of putting on a play. “You’re discovering new things, and it’s amazing to see where the performance started versus where it ends up,” she shared. “I became so much more comfortable onstage towards the end of the run [with John Proctor ], so when I was talking about doing Romeo & Juliet on the West End, that’s a much more demanding role, but I thought, ‘I think I’m ready for that.’”

Meanwhile, Photo: Getty Images John Proctor Is the Villain is now being made into a movie, and while Sink isn’t reprising her role as Shelby, she is playing the role of executive producer, introducing her to a completely new avenue of the entertainment industry. “You get more creative say, you’re taking it to studios, finding a home for it,” she explained of the new gig, adding that once she found out the play was going to Hollywood, she really wanted to “have a handprint” on the project in some way, given her familiarity with the material. “When you’re in it and focusing on a character, you have a really narrow view of things. When you step outside [of the character], it opens up the whole world. From being in the rehearsal room, I have a deep understanding of the play and the entire world, and how do we take that from one room on a stage and open it up for movie?" (Sink is also acting in and serving as executive producer on The Marriage Plot, a TV adaptation of the 2011 novel by Jeffrey Eugenides, for FX. )

Notably, As for future acting roles, Sink shared that she feels really privileged to be able to choose projects that align with where she is right now. “When you do find something that clicks, you just know . It’s a gut instinct, a story you want to tell,” she explained. “I look for something that is stretching and building new muscles and finding joy in it. It’s OK to do stuff because it’s fun. Because you can have challenging roles, but I want to leave room for having fun.”

As per the latest buzz, Her creative process in developing a character, whether it’s Juliet from Romeo & Juliet or the young woman in Taylor Swift’s “All Too Well” music video , really depends on the role. For example, Sink spent a year working on Shakespeare, learning how to translate Juliet’s words into her own voice. She’s also gotten more comfortable speaking up and building her own interpretation of a character. “When I was younger, I’d have ideas but wouldn’t share them," Sink told the Teen Vogue Fest crowd. “I was shy and wouldn’t recognize my potential. Now I know my instincts have value and I should follow them.”

In further updates, Photo: Getty Images Entering the Marvel Universe is a very big deal for any young star, and though Sink’s Spider-Man role is shrouded in secrecy, she did share that she was “super excited” to become part of the Spiderverse. It also felt like the flipside of her work on Stranger Things; this time, she was the newbie on set. “You don’t always know what to expect when you’re stepping into such a big franchise… [with] people who have been playing those characters for ten years, which was like Stranger Things,” she shared. But everyone was “so warm, lovely, and relaxed,” which helped her settle into her (still-as-yet-unannounced) character. (Don’t worry, there’s not long to wait! Brand New Day comes out July 31.)

On top of that, Sink shared she feels “really fortunate” that the thing she wanted to do as a child—acting!—is still the thing she loves and feels like she’s meant to do today. “I never really reached a point where I was like, ‘Do I want to continue acting?’ I always knew,” she shared. But she still feels like she has a lot to learn. “That takes time and experience, and putting yourself in challenging situations that will grow your skill set. I feel like chasing challenges is what really helped me feel more confident in what I’m doing.”

title: Wesneski to make first MLB start in nearly 15 months: 'I don’t know how to act'
body: Here's what's trending across the USA right now:
Wesneski to make first MLB start in nearly 15 months: 'I don’t know how to act' 2:24 AM UTC Brian McTaggart

Adding to this, ANAHEIM -- More pitching help is on the way for the Astros, with right-hander Hayden Wesneski slated to be reinstated from the injured list and start Wednesday’s series finale against the Angels at Angel Stadium.

Meanwhile, Wesenski, one of three players the Astros acquired in December 2024 from the Cubs in the Kyle Tucker trade, will be pitching in a Major League game for the first time since May 6, 2025. He was in the Houston rotation to begin last year and was 1-3 with a 4.50 ERA in 32 innings before getting injured.

Notably, “I’m going to be nervous,” he shared. “I’m excited about it. I don’t know how to act tomorrow, to be honest with you. The first time I threw off the mound in the FCL [Florida Complex League], it was big time. Tomorrow, I can’t tell you how I’ll act, but I’ll figure it out.”

As per the latest buzz, Wesneski, a Houston native who was 9-13 with a 3.93 ERA in 190 innings in three seasons with the Cubs, is the second Astros pitcher to return from Tommy John surgery this month. Right-hander Ronel Blanco returned July 20 and has made two starts, posting an 8.10 ERA. In fact, Blanco and Wesneski both had Tommy John surgery within a couple weeks of each other and pushed each other through the recovery.

In further updates, “Certain times were fine and certain times it wasn’t,” Wesneski shared. “It had ebbs and flows. The first eight weeks with the brace weren’t great, but having Ronel Blanco next to me really did help a lot. He’s a great person and he helped push me and keep me motivated. There were times in Florida [during rehab] it was getting a little dull and boring, but we worked through it. Obviously, I’m very excited for tomorrow.”

On top of that, Wesneski posted a 2.25 ERA in five Minor League rehab starts, striking out 21 batters in 20 innings. In his final rehab start Friday at Triple-A Sugar Land, he struck out seven batters, throwing 80 pitches, 49 for strikes, while topping out at 95.9 mph.

“The stuff has felt good,” he shared. “There are times it felt inconsistent, but for the most part I’ve thrown a lot of strikes, which is the biggest deal. I’m spinning it well. There’s little inconsistencies here and there, but having five starts and the amount of strikes I’ve thrown, for the most part I’ve commanded the ball pretty well.”

title: High-speed chase through LA includes suspect's dangerous encounter with dirt bike riders on 110 Fwy.

Just before 6:30 p.m., the driver exited the freeway and entered a downtown L.A. parking structure at the intersection of Hill and Eighth streets.

title: Shilpa Shetty breaks silence after reservation post goes viral: “I am shocked to see fake statements falsely attached to my name”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
The star has denied any connection to the widely shared message on caste-based reservation, urging social media users not to believe fabricated claims circulating online.

Adding to this, The widely shared post, which was widely shared online, read, “Don’t touch reservation. Let general category doctors treat only general category patients and let everyone else treat only patients from their own caste. Do this for a few years and people will start asking to end caste-based reservation themselves. You can't get skill through reservation.”

Meanwhile, As the post continued to circulate with her name attached to it, Shilpa Shetty took to social media to set the record straight and distance herself from the message. The star categorically denied authoring or endorsing the statement, describing it as fabricated. Addressing the issue, Shilpa wrote, “I am shocked to see fake statements on reservation falsely attached to my name. This is completely fabricated, malicious garbage. Do not fall for this fake news.”
Notably, I am shocked to see fake statements on reservation falsely attached to my name. This is completely fabricated, malicious garbage.
As per the latest buzz, — SHILPA SHETTY KUNDRA (@TheShilpaShetty) July 28, 2026

In further updates, With this statement, the star made it clear that the widely shared message did not originate from her and urged people not to believe or further circulate misinformation carrying her name. Shilpa's response has since been widely shared online, with many users appreciating her prompt clarification while urging others to verify information before forwarding or engaging with widely shared posts.

On top of that, The clarification comes at a time when misinformation and fabricated star statements continue to spread rapidly across social media platforms, often leading to confusion among users. Public figures have increasingly had to address such instances directly to prevent false narratives from gaining credibility.

For now, Shilpa Shetty has unequivocally shared that the reservation-related message circulating online has no connection to her. title: Kangana Ranaut calls Gen Z “Generation Gutter” days after NEET protest, questions their upbringing: “So jarring and crass all at once”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

Adding to this, Sharing her views on social media, Kangana shared she was disturbed by the language and behaviour seen in videos from the protests: "Never in my life have I seen so much ugliness in one place. These reels from Gen Z protests are puke-inducing. The way they speak and the kind of language they are using... never in my life have I seen everything in each and every frame so jarring and so crass all at once."
Meanwhile, She further questioned the upbringing of the protesters, writing: "Ewww, who is birthing and raising them?"

Notably, Referring to protesters who had described themselves as "cockroaches," Kangana wrote: "India is a place of diversely beautiful people, draped in elegance and rooted in cultural sophistication. You call yourself cockroaches and look/behave like them as well. There is no paradox or juxtaposition there, just simply subjecting the world to your filth, garbage and ugliness. I am scarred from these reels. I need some healing, digital detox."

As per the latest buzz, The star also made comments about women who participated in the protests, referring to them as "so-called westernised Indian women." She alleged that they "proudly flaunt their freedom to have drugs, drinks and shamelessly live off their parents' earnings."

In further updates, Kangana further wrote: "I call them Generation Gutter. Some of them have nothing to offer to the system. They are not good at studies. They are so ugly and corrupt that they can't even be homemakers."

On top of that, This is not the first time Kangana has spoken about the ongoing student protests. In earlier social media posts, she questioned the methods adopted by the protesters and criticised attempts to pressure the government through street demonstrations.

title: Kuch Kuch Hota Hai child star Sana Saeed reveals she battled Bulimia: “For six years I had no name for what I was going through”
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

In a recent conversation with Hindustan Times, Sana shared that she spent six years without understanding what she was experiencing, and it took another four years after her diagnosis to fully recover.

Adding to this, Speaking about her journey, Sana admitted that she carried a great deal of shame because she believed she was the only person facing such struggles: "For six years I had no name for what I was going through."

Meanwhile, She explained that not knowing what she was dealing with made the experience even more isolating. Recalling the turning point in her recovery, Sana shared: "I was desperate to get better and find a healthy way to eat, and eventually I came across a book on recovery that gave me the language for what I was actually dealing with."
Notably, The star added that it took her four years to fully recover from Bulimia.

As per the latest buzz, Sana shared she decided to speak publicly only after reaching a place of healing, hoping her story could help others going through similar experiences: "Now that I'm healed, it matters to me deeply that if my story helps even one person feel less alone in theirs, that's worth more than the discomfort of being vulnerable in public."

In further updates, The Student of the Year star also reflected on the pressure surrounding appearance in the entertainment industry. She recalled that conversations during her college years often revolved around dieting and losing weight.

On top of that, Speaking about the impact of working in front of the camera, Sana shared constant scrutiny over appearance can complicate a person's relationship with their body: "Being on camera, being commented on, having your appearance be part of the job description."
Looking back, she admitted she did not have the emotional tools at the time to separate her self-worth from how she looked, something she now understands much better after her recovery.

In further updates, The movie's selection at the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne marks an early milestone ahead of its rollout and allows it to connect with audiences on the international festival circuit.

title: EXCLUSIVE: CBFC deletes 8-second-long kissing scene in Spider-Man: Brand New Day; mutes 'obscene' words in 3 places
body: Here's the latest update from the Hollywood/Marvel world:
The Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC) passed the movie with a U/A 13+ certificate. However, the studio was asked to make a few changes.

Adding to this, To begin with, ‘obscene’ words were muted and removed in the audio and subtitles at three places - one in the first half and the remaining two in the post-interval portion. Secondly, visuals of a lip-lock lasting 8 seconds were asked to be deleted.

Meanwhile, Once these changes were made, the studio was handed over the certificate of Spider-Man: Brand New Day on July 23. The length of the movie, as mentioned on the censor certificate, is 144.52 minutes. In other words, Spider-Man: Brand New Day is 2 hours, 24 minutes and 52 seconds long.

Notably, Spider-Man: Brand New Day brings back Tom Holland, Zendaya and Jacob Batalon and follows the events of Spider-Man: No Way Home (2021). As per a Bollywood Hungama report on July 26, the movie sold 2.60 lakh tickets across the top 3 national chains, PVRInox and Cinepolis, and with 3 days still to go, is headed to clock advances in the range of 4 lakhs. Hence, the movie now has a chance to open at Rs. 50 crores on a working Thursday, which is unheard of for a Hollywood movie.

As per the latest buzz, Bollywood Hungama also reported yesterday that cinemas have been asked to implement mega-smash hit pricing bands. A source told us, “In a few cinemas, the rates are at par with Dhurandhar The Revenge , but in most theatres and multiplexes, the rates are lower than the Ranveer Singh-starrer. This is because Dhurandhar sequel’s buzz was historic and one-of-a-kind.”

title: SCOOP: Ranbir Kapoor opts out of Dhoom 4; YRF to recast for the iconic franchise
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

“Dhoom 4 was initially set to be helmed by Ayan Mukerji, but after War 2, Aditya Chopra decided against entrusting the project to the filmmaker. However, Ranbir remained a part of the movie and was awaiting clarity from Aditya Chopra,” a source told Bollywood Hungama .

Adding to this, After several rounds of discussions, Ranbir decided to part ways with the Dhoom franchise. “Ranbir is no longer doing Dhoom 4. He has started meeting writers and directors to explore other subjects. He was not convinced by the script, which led to this decision and shocked everyone. While Dhoom is one of India’s biggest franchises, for Ranbir, the story has always come before everything else.”

Meanwhile, However, trade sources offered a different perspective on the project's status. "The script for Dhoom 4 is still being developed. No casting has been decided at this stage," claimed trade multiple sources.

Notably, While trade sources have maintained that no casting decisions have been finalised, other sources insist that Ranbir Kapoor is no longer associated with the project and that YRF will eventually have to look at other casting options once the script is locked. Meanwhile, the star is gearing up for the rollout of Ramayana on Diwali, followed by Love & War on Republic Day.

title: Prime Video India partners with CJ ENM to bring over 100 Korean titles; details inside!
body: Here's the latest on what's streaming and coming up:
Prime Video India has partnered with CJ ENM to bring over 100 Korean titles, including 26 new releases, to Indian audiences over the next two years.

Adding to this, The agreement builds on the existing global partnership between Prime Video and CJ ENM, with a stronger focus on Indian audiences. The soon-to-release titles will be available with English subtitles as well as Hindi, Tamil and Telugu dubs.

Meanwhile, The slate will begin with Yumi's Cells Season Three and will also include soon-to-release series such as The Legend of Kitchen Soldier, My Bias, My Boss and Filing for Love. In addition, viewers will get access to several existing CJ ENM titles, including Dear X, Law in the City, Study Group, My Dearest Nemesis, Search: WWW, and the first two seasons of Yumi's Cells.
Notably, The collection features a mix of romance, thriller, fantasy, drama and action, with actors including Kim You-jung, Lee Jong-suk, Park Ji-hoon and Cha Woo-min.

As per the latest buzz, Speaking about the partnership, Shilangi Mukherji, Director and Head of SVOD Business at Prime Video India, shared the collaboration reflects the increasing popularity of Korean stories among Indian audiences: "Building on our strong global relationship with CJ ENM and the deal revealed last year, we're excited to deepen this collaboration with a sharper focus on India. The popularity of Korean content has been remarkable across our Prime Video markets. Compelling narratives, diverse genres, and memorable characters that transcend borders have fueled a K-content wave that continues to gain momentum year on year. By bringing a curated slate of premium Korean titles to Prime Video, we're doubling down on our commitment to making the most innovative and captivating stories from Korea accessible to audiences in India."

In further updates, Manish Menghani, Director and Head of Content Licensing at Prime Video India, shared the partnership is driven by audience preferences: "At Prime Video India, we keep a keen eye on what our customers are watching and what stories resonate with them. The surge in popularity of K-content is undeniable. CJ ENM is one of the biggest entertainment studios in Korea, with an expansive library of much-loved titles. The continued success of our global content deal with CJ ENM is a testament to this growing demand. For us, this deal is not only the natural step forward, backed by customer preferences, but also a reflection of commitment to making Prime Video India the go-to destination for the best international content."

On top of that, Jangho Seo, Executive Vice President of Platform Division at CJ ENM, shared the company sees India as an important market for expanding the reach of Korean storytelling: "We are pleased to collaborate with Prime Video India to bring CJ ENM's acclaimed K-dramas to a wider audience in one of the world's most dynamic entertainment markets. Prime Video's unmatched reach in India, combined with its deep investment in local audiences, makes it the ideal partner to amplify our content to millions of new viewers. This partnership reflects our ongoing commitment to expanding the global reach of Korean storytelling."
The new titles will be available to Prime members in India at no additional cost as part of their subscription.

title: Yami Gautam to star in Sujoy Ghosh's Kahaani 3: Report
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Unlike the previous films starring Vidya Balan, the third chapter will introduce a completely new story set in the same Kahaani universe.

Adding to this, Unlike the previous two films, the soon-to-release chapter will not continue the story of Vidya Balan's iconic character. Instead, the makers are developing an entirely new narrative set within the same Kahaani universe, aiming to preserve the franchise's signature suspense while introducing a different central character and storyline.

Meanwhile, Sharing details about the project, a source shared, “ Kahaani 3 is a new story altogether. The idea is to take the franchise forward while retaining the essence of the world that audiences have loved. Yami Gautam is coming on board as the lead, and the character has a very strong arc. The movie is still in the pre-production stage, and the team is working on the timelines for the shoot.”

Notably, The source further added, “Sujoy has a very clear vision for the Kahaani world. He is working closely with the team to ensure that the third movie feels fresh but still carries the soul of the franchise. There is a lot of excitement around the collaboration with Yami, and the makers are currently figuring out the shoot schedule.”

As per the latest buzz, The original Kahaani , rolled out in 2012, featured Vidya Balan as a pregnant woman searching for her missing husband in Kolkata. The thriller received widespread acclaim for its gripping narrative, unexpected twists, and Vidya's standout performance.

In further updates, The franchise returned in 2016 with Kahaani 2: Durga Rani Singh , starring Vidya Balan and Arjun Rampal. Although it was not a direct sequel, the movie delivered another suspense-driven story filled with emotional depth and surprising turns, further cementing Kahaani as one of Bollywood's most admired thriller franchises. With Kahaani 3 now in pre-production, audiences can expect a fresh mystery while staying connected to the world that made the series a fan favourite.

title: Delhi High Court orders removal of Kala Hiran teaser linked to Salman Khan; says reputation must be protected
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:
Justice Jyoti Singh shared that if the producer failed to remove the teaser, platforms such as X and YouTube would be directed to take down the links.

Adding to this, The matter arose from Salman Khan's plea seeking protection of his personality rights. The star had earlier secured directions from the court protecting those rights and later moved an application seeking a ban on Kala Hiran , claiming it was based on the pending blackbuck poaching case.

Meanwhile, According to Khan, the movie portrays him as having links to the underworld and contains defamatory material that infringes upon his personality rights. He also argued that the project could affect his right to a fair trial, as proceedings in the alleged blackbuck hunting case are still pending before the Rajasthan High Court and the Supreme Court.

Notably, The plea further shared that the movie's poster features a character closely resembling Khan, complete with a bracelet commonly associated with the star. It also referred to media reports and statements made by producer Amit Jani, claiming they clearly indicate that the movie is based on the sub judice case.

As per the latest buzz, The petition also claimed that after Khan sent a legal notice to the filmmakers, Amit Jani publicly tore it up during an interview and later alleged on social media that he was being threatened by the star and the underworld.
In further updates, During the hearing, Justice Singh strongly criticised the producer's conduct, observing that the teaser continued to damage the star's reputation every moment it remained online.

On top of that, The court also remarked that such treatment would be unacceptable even if it involved an ordinary citizen, stressing that a person's reputation takes years to build but can be lost very quickly.

Appearing for the producer, counsel argued that the teaser never names Salman Khan and does not use artificial intelligence or deepfake technology. It was also submitted that the teaser merely depicts public events and that there is no exclusive legal protection preventing such portrayals.

title: Katrina Kaif NOT returning with Prabhas' Spirit, casting reports dismissed as 'completely inaccurate'
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The latest round of rumours suggested that Katrina had been cast opposite Prabhas in Sandeep Reddy Vanga's much-awaited action drama Spirit . The reports also claimed that the movie would mark her return to Telugu cinema after nearly two decades, leaving followers excited about the possibility.
Adding to this, However, it appears that the speculation has no basis. A well-placed industry source has dismissed the reports, calling them "completely inaccurate and misleading."

Meanwhile, The source shared, "There is absolutely no truth to the claims being made about Katrina Kaif's future acting plans. The report is based entirely on speculation and misinformation, with no verification." The clarification puts an end, at least for now, to the rumours linking the star with one of the most anticipated films currently in production.

Notably, Interestingly, Spirit has remained in the spotlight ever since it was revealed, with its casting generating frequent headlines. Over the past few years, several reports have linked different actors to the project. Earlier, there were rumours that star couple Kareena Kapoor Khan and Saif Ali Khan were being considered for important roles in the movie.

As per the latest buzz, The project later became the subject of widespread discussion after Deepika Padukone as per reports exited the movie. Industry reports suggested that the star stepped away following disagreements over remuneration and work conditions. She was subsequently replaced by Triptii Dimri, who previously collaborated with director Sandeep Reddy Vanga in Animal .

In further updates, Besides Prabhas and Triptii Dimri, Spirit also stars Vivek Oberoi in a pivotal role. The movie is currently one of the most awaited releases from Vanga and is slated to hit theatres on March 5, 2027.

title: Pankaj Tripathi to receive Artist of Distinction honour at Indian Film Festival of Melbourne 2026
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

The honour marks yet another milestone in Pankaj Tripathi's career, which spans critically acclaimed performances across films and streaming platforms. From portraying deeply rooted, everyday characters to delivering some of contemporary Indian cinema's most memorable performances, the star has collected widespread admiration for his authenticity, understated brilliance and unwavering commitment to storytelling.

Adding to this, From the unforgettable Sultan Qureshi in Gangs of Wasseypur and the beloved Kaleen Bhaiya in Mirzapur, to his National Award-winning performance in Mimi and acclaimed roles in Newton, Stree, Bareilly Ki Barfi, Fukrey, Masaan , Criminal Justice, OMG 2 and Main Atal Hoon , Tripathi has consistently redefined excellence with characters that have become cultural touchstones. His ability to portray ordinary people with extraordinary sincerity has collected him immense critical acclaim and a devoted global fan following.

Meanwhile, Expressing his gratitude on receiving the honour, Pankaj Tripathi shared, "To be soon receiving the 'Artist of Distinction' honour at the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne is deeply humbling. As an star, I have always believed that stories have the extraordinary power to transcend boundaries, connect hearts and bring people closer, irrespective of language or geography. To have my journey be recognised on an international platform like IFFM is truly special and incredibly meaningful. Every milestone in my career has been possible because of the trust and collaboration of filmmakers, writers, directors, fellow actors, technicians and, above all, the audiences who have embraced my work with so much love. This recognition belongs as much to them as it does to me. Coming from a small village in Bihar, I never imagined that the stories I would become a part of would one day travel across the world and be celebrated in this manner."

Notably, He also added, "What makes this honour even more memorable is that I will be attending the festival in person for the very first time. I am looking forward to interacting with audiences in Australia, celebrating the incredible journey of Indian cinema, and sharing this moment with fellow artists from across the industry. My heartfelt gratitude to the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne for this honour. It is something I will always cherish."

As per the latest buzz, Mitu Bowmick Lange, the director of the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne, shared, "Pankaj Tripathi is one of the finest actors of our generation, an artist whose performances transcend language, geography and culture. His extraordinary ability to bring authenticity, empathy and quiet power to every character has made him one of the most respected voices in Indian cinema today. It is our absolute privilege to honour Pankaj Tripathi with the 'Artist of Distinction' Award at the Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne. This recognition celebrates not only his remarkable body of work but also his immense contribution to storytelling that resonates with audiences across the world. His journey from humble beginnings to becoming one of India's most acclaimed actors is deeply inspiring and reflects the transformative power of cinema."

In further updates, Over the years, Pankaj Tripathi has established himself as one of the most respected performers in Indian cinema, effortlessly moving between commercial successes and critically acclaimed projects. His ability to bring emotional depth, honesty and relatability to every character has collected him numerous accolades, including a National Movie Award, while also making him a favourite among audiences across generations. The 'Artist of Distinction' Award further cements his legacy as an star whose work has not only enriched Indian cinema but has also strengthened its global appeal. As he prepares to attend the festival in Melbourne for the first time, the honour celebrates not just an extraordinary performer, but also the enduring power of authentic storytelling that continues to transcend borders and inspire audiences around the world.

On top of that, The Indian Movie Festival of Melbourne 2026 will take place from August 13th to 23rd, bringing together an exciting and diverse line-up of films, filmmakers, actors and industry talent from across India and the world. As the largest celebration of Indian cinema outside India, IFFM continues to serve as a powerful platform for showcasing the richness, diversity and global influence of Indian storytelling. Pankaj Tripathi's 'Artist of Distinction' Award presentation at the iconic Palais Theatre on August 13, will be one of the festival's marquee events, celebrating an star whose extraordinary body of work has left an indelible mark on Indian and global cinema.

title: EXCLUSIVE: Kartik Aaryan-starrer Naagzilla wraps shoot on a sweet note; Ravi Kishan and team celebrate as Mahaveer Jain, Mrighdeep Singh Lamba say, "Dharma is the BEST company to partner with"
body: Here's the latest update from the Bollywood world:

A source told Bollywood Hungama , “Most of the shoot of Naagzilla had been completed, but one day of filming remained. It took place yesterday, Sunday, July 26, in Mumbai. Ravi Kishan was present along with director Mrighdeep Singh Lamba, writer Gautam Mehra and co-producer Divyansh Jain. They were jubilant about the wrap but also emotional, as they had shared a fun-filled and memorable journey while making the movie. It was a hectic yet highly exciting shoot for the cast and crew.”

Adding to this, The source further shared, “To celebrate the occasion, a cake bearing the words ‘Naagzilla Movie Wrap’ was brought in and enjoyed by the cast and crew. Incidentally, July 25 was director Mrighdeep Singh Lamba’s birthday, which further added to the celebratory mood on the sets of Naagzilla .”

Meanwhile, On this joyous occasion, Mahaveer Jain and Mrighdeep Singh Lamba jointly told Bollywood Hungama , “Dharma Productions is the best company to partner with. Karan Johar, Apoorva Mehta, Marijke DeSouza, Azeem Dayani and their entire team are simply the best. Also, we are thankful to each and every crew member of Naagzilla . Everyone has worked really hard to execute this grand vision.”

Notably, Naagzilla ’s lead star, Kartik Aaryan, who of late won his first National Award, was not present on the sets, as he had completed filming his portion earlier this year. The source continued, “Now that the shoot is 100% complete, Mrighdeep Singh Lamba and his team are fully focused on post-production and the VFX. The movie is set in a crazy world and is packed with maddening humour. According to the makers, its quirky world, outrageous comedy, solid casting and chartbuster soundtrack will draw audiences to cinemas.”
As per the latest buzz, Naagzilla is produced by Karan Johar’s Dharma Productions and Mahaveer Jain’s Mahaveer Jain Films. It releases in cinemas on February 12, 2027.

title: Pankaj Tripathi starrer Ohh My Dog release postponed to August 7 due to Spider-Man: Brand New Day screen shortage
body: Here's the latest update from the Hollywood/Marvel world:
The Amit Rai directorial has as per reports been pushed by a week after facing a shortage of screens despite receiving its CBFC clearance.

Adding to this, According to sources close to the development, the makers of Ohh My Dog have been facing a shortage of screens as exhibitors are expected to prioritize Spider-Man: Brand New Day , one of the most eagerly awaited films in the Marvel Cinematic Universe. Headlined by Tom Holland and Zendaya, the superhero entertainer is expected to command a massive theatrical rollout, making it challenging for smaller films to secure adequate showcasing.

Meanwhile, The postponement is believed to be a strategic move aimed at ensuring Ohh My Dog receives better screen availability and a stronger theatrical presence. While the makers are yet to make an official announcement regarding the revised rollout date, the movie is expected to hit cinemas a week later than originally planned.

Notably, Filmmaker Amit Rai shared the decision to postpone Oh My Dog was "a very practical decision," driven by intense competition for screens rather than any concerns about the movie itself. He explained that theaters are already occupied by major releases like Odyssey and Dhamaal 4, while Spider-Man is expected to "create history" with an opening of "around Rs. 50 crores," leaving little room for other films.

As per the latest buzz, Since Oh My Dog is also a family entertainer, Rai shared its audience overlaps with those films. "Even after making such a good movie, the reason won't be anything else... the reason will be that we simply won't have the space to occupy screens." He added that without enough screens, the movie's marketing and rollout strategy would not be able to unfold as planned. "It has all the potential, but it just won't have the space."

In further updates, Explaining the postponement, Rai shared the team decided to "step aside briefly," delay the rollout by a week, and return when audiences had already watched the bigger releases. "By then, there will be a little space, and we might be able to grow there. That is the very valid reason behind shifting the rollout," he shared.

On top of that, The delay comes just days after Ohh My Dog successfully completed its certification process with the Central Board of Movie Certification (CBFC). The movie has been awarded a U/A certificate, although the board directed a few modifications before granting clearance.

Among the changes mandated by the CBFC, references to brands including 'Truecaller' and 'Dettol' have been muted, along with a cuss word used in the movie. A sequence involving a dog has also been shortened by two seconds, while a photo frame of Lord Hanuman appearing in one scene has been blurred. Additionally, the board instructed the makers to include two disclaimers—one addressing child labour, which forms part of the movie's narrative, and another on human trafficking.
